name: 星鯨
prompt: a colossal whale swimming through the night sky among stars, its body drawn with constellation lines, tiny villages with lanterns on its back, clouds as waves
desc: 馱著整片夜空漫遊的巨鯨,背上住著守星人。

name: 時間之樹
prompt: a gigantic ancient tree whose leaves are round clock faces, falling leaves drifting upward, roots in a still mirror lake, tiny figure at its foot
desc: 每片葉子是一個時辰,落葉的地方時間倒流。

name: 月影女王
prompt: a queen in a long gown made of the phases of the moon standing on a mirror-like lake, crown of crescent horns, her reflection a different figure
desc: 她的長裙是月相,倒影裡站著另一個她。

name: 天樞浮城
prompt: a floating city of pagodas, bridges and towers on a cloud island held by great chains and sails, airships docking, waterfalls falling off the edge into mist
desc: 飄在雲上的城,以鎖鏈與風帆維繫。

name: 無名之書
prompt: a huge open book on a stone altar whose pages are living ink, ink creatures and rivers climbing out of the pages into the air
desc: 書頁是活的墨,翻開哪頁,就會有東西爬出來。

name: 霧鹿
prompt: a tall stag made of drifting mist with branching antlers that hold glowing paper lanterns, walking through a misty forest
desc: 鹿角掛著燈籠,霧起時才現身。

name: 燈籠水母
prompt: a large jellyfish floating in the air like a lantern, glowing bell and long trailing tentacles, over a dark valley with fireflies
desc: 夜裡順風漂浮,所到之處亮起微光。

name: 鐘樓鴞
prompt: an owl with clockwork brass wings and gear-filled chest perched on an old clock tower at midnight
desc: 每敲一下鐘,牠的齒輪就轉一圈。

name: 墨匠
prompt: a painter in a wide sleeved robe with a giant brush painting a living tiger and waves into the air from his brush strokes
desc: 筆下所畫,皆會活過來。

name: 風語者
prompt: a figure in a robe made of many colorful kites, hair streaming, standing on a cliff listening to the wind, birds around
desc: 聽得懂風說的每一句話。

name: 守夜機偶
prompt: a tall clockwork automaton with a lantern for a head holding a staff, walking through a sleeping town at night
desc: 燈籠是頭,走遍小鎮,夜夜守望。

name: 倒影鏡
prompt: an ornate standing mirror in a ruined hall showing a bright different world instead of the room, mist at its base
desc: 鏡裡的世界,和這裡不一樣。

name: 紙船燈
prompt: a paper boat holding a lit candle floating down a dark river carrying tiny wishes, lotus-like glow
desc: 載著願望,順水流向看不見的地方。

name: 倒懸瀑布
prompt: a waterfall flowing upward from a pool into the sky, rocks and mist, tiny bridge and pavilion beside it
desc: 水從地上流向天,反過來看世界。

name: 鯨骨橋
prompt: a giant whale skeleton forming a bridge across a deep canyon with small lanterns hung along the ribs and travelers crossing
desc: 巨鯨的遺骨,成了兩岸之間的橋。

name: 墨貓
prompt: a cat whose body is made of flowing black ink, tail trailing ink droplets, sitting on a stack of old books
desc: 碰到的紙,都會留下爪印。

name: 銅鱗魚
prompt: a koi with bronze metallic scales swimming through the air among clouds and bamboo
desc: 在雲裡游,不在水裡游。

name: 雲羊
prompt: a sheep whose wool is a fluffy cloud grazing on a mountain top, a small rainbow above
desc: 下雨前,牠的毛會變灰。

name: 蘑菇精
prompt: a tiny mushroom spirit with a large cap hat holding a small lantern in a mossy forest
desc: 雨後長出來,天亮就不見。

name: 燈蛾
prompt: a giant moth with softly glowing patterned wings resting on a branch in a dark forest
desc: 翅膀的花紋,每晚都不一樣。

name: 提燈少女
prompt: a young girl with a large paper lantern walking down a misty stone path in the night
desc: 她的燈,只照得到回家的路。

name: 流浪鐘表匠
prompt: a wandering clockmaker pulling a cart full of clocks and gears along a country road, a bird on his hat
desc: 修得好各式各樣的鐘,唯獨修不好時間。

name: 星象師
prompt: an astronomer with a brass astrolabe and long telescope on a tower top under a starry sky with constellations drawn in the clouds
desc: 每顆星的脾氣,他都記得。

name: 渡船人
prompt: a ferryman poling a small boat with a lantern at the bow through a misty river at dusk
desc: 擺渡的不只是人,也有心事。

name: 星砂瓶
prompt: a glass bottle filled with glowing star sand on a wooden table, tiny stars floating out of the cork
desc: 倒出來的,是一小撮夜空。

name: 發條蝴蝶
prompt: a clockwork butterfly with brass gear wings and a winding key resting on a flower
desc: 上一次發條,能飛一整個下午。

name: 傘中雨
prompt: an umbrella with a small rainstorm swirling inside it, droplets falling upward, held by a hand
desc: 收起來之前,記得先把雨倒掉。

name: 雲海書店
prompt: a small bookshop with a lantern on a cliff edge above a sea of clouds, stacks of books outside, a tiny cat on the steps
desc: 要翻過雲海,才找得到的書店。

name: 螢火谷
prompt: a deep valley filled with thousands of fireflies and a winding stream, mist and dark hills
desc: 夏夜,整座山谷會呼吸。

name: 浮島群
prompt: a group of small floating islands with single trees and waterfalls connected by rope bridges in a pale sky
desc: 島與島之間,只靠繩橋相連。

name: 銀魚
prompt: a silver fish leaping from a calm pond with ripples
desc: 一躍,便是一道光。

name: 小雲龍
prompt: a tiny dragon made of cloud curling around a mountain peak
desc: 還沒長大,只會下毛毛雨。

name: 苔蘚熊
prompt: a bear covered in thick green moss sleeping among ferns
desc: 睡得太久,身上長了一座森林。

name: 紙鶴
prompt: a paper crane coming alive and flying over a quiet lake
desc: 折得夠用心,它就會飛。

name: 蛙燈
prompt: a frog with a small glowing lamp on its head sitting on a lily pad
desc: 夜裡替迷路的螢火蟲帶路。

name: 賣夢人
prompt: a dream seller with a tall backpack of glowing jars walking through a night street
desc: 一罐一個夢,童叟無欺。

name: 撐葉小孩
prompt: a small child holding a huge leaf as an umbrella standing in the rain
desc: 一片葉子,就是一把傘。

name: 老茶師
prompt: an old tea master with a long beard sitting beside a tiny stove and tea set under a pine
desc: 茶涼了,故事才開始。

name: 風箏少年
prompt: a boy running on a hill flying a big colorful kite shaped like a fish
desc: 線的另一頭,是整片天空。

name: 風鈴
prompt: a wind chime of small bells and glass hanging from a roof in a breeze
desc: 風來了,它才說話。

name: 空燈籠
prompt: an empty paper lantern hanging on a bare branch at dusk
desc: 等著有人,把光放進去。

name: 舊地圖
prompt: an old folded map with faded ink lines and a compass on a table
desc: 上面的地方,有些已經不存在了。

name: 墨錠
prompt: an ink stick and an inkstone with a brush on a wooden table
desc: 磨一磨,世界就黑得很好看。

name: 紙風車
prompt: a small paper pinwheel spinning in the wind in a grass field
desc: 小小的風,也能轉一個夏天。

name: 骨笛
prompt: a bone flute lying on a mossy stone with a thin curl of mist
desc: 吹出來的,是很遠的聲音。

name: 霧中石階
prompt: a long stone staircase climbing into thick mist with a single lantern
desc: 往上走,看不見盡頭。

name: 湖面月影
prompt: a calm lake with the moon reflected and a tiny boat, reeds on the shore
desc: 月亮掉進了湖裡。

name: 雨巷
prompt: a narrow rainy alley with wet cobblestones and a glowing window and an umbrella
desc: 雨落在巷子裡,有點孤單。

name: 雲間梯田
prompt: terraced fields on a mountain slope above the clouds with a small hut
desc: 種田的人,住在雲上。

name: 孤島小舟
prompt: a tiny island with one tree and a small boat tied at the shore on a still sea at dawn
desc: 一棵樹,一艘船,一整片海。
